name: Quest Body
opportunities: A person's Quest data and the tools around it change for reasons of their own, so the one declared place where that data lives lets every other part stay unaware of how Quest stores it.
solution_coherence: Quest Body is the form of the assistant and the Quest data that belongs to the person. Quest Body checks every claim about an account through Quest Account Truth, and takes requests in from where people work through Intake Sources. Quest Account Truth reads the account as it stands when the AI speaks, through Quest Context, which keeps each person's own notes, goals and decisions apart from everyone else's.
